entities.name: Q8BWQ1
observations: Exact 534-aa sequence match to reviewed Mus musculus UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2A3 (100% identity and coverage).
Catalyzes glucuronic-acid conjugation of hyodeoxycholic, deoxycholic, chenodeoxycholic, and ursodeoxycholic acids; conjugation supports solubility and excretion.
Annotated as membrane-associated, single-pass type I membrane protein; sequence has N-terminal signal peptide-like hydrophobic segment and C-terminal transmembrane anchor.
GO annotations include glucuronosyltransferase activity, bile acid metabolic process, and xenobiotic metabolic process; evidence includes experimental and similarity-based annotations.

entities.name: Bile acid metabolism
observations: UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2A3 is annotated with a role in bile acid metabolism, including glucuronidation of several bile acids.

entities.name: Xenobiotic metabolism
observations: UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2A3 is annotated with a role in xenobiotic metabolism through glucuronidation.

entities.name: Cell membrane
observations: Mouse UGT2A3 is annotated as a membrane-associated single-pass type I membrane protein.
